verdict.rationale: Proa documents Suspense boundaries that stream ready chunks out of order so slow data does not block the page, and typed loader caching through WebContext. That gives a server-side loading-UI path for slow data. Signals exist only for client islands, though, and no resource primitive is shown that turns server-loaded data into reactive state. missing for 10: a documented resource/async-data primitive, evidence that loaded data becomes reactive client state, docs on Suspense fallback/loading UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
